name: convention-default-export-through-a-specifier
description: A default export written as an export specifier naming a top-level constant is read through to the constant's initializer, and a template literal with no substitution is a literal, so the property moves the directory. The fixture assumes the analyzer carries a row named react-router for the package @react-router/dev, holding the installed version in its range, whose entry globs name root.ts below an app directory that defaults to app and that the appDirectory property of react-router.config.ts moves.
